plain_english_policy: Directly fund public or nonprofit acquisition/protection of undeveloped land to maintain natural areas, agricultural buffers, or scenic corridors.

effects.rationale: Explicitly targets preservation of undeveloped land, not resource extraction or development.
Preservation inherently limits future development on preserved lands.
Funding is directed to government or nonprofit entities, not private actors.
Preservation requires ongoing stewardship (e.g., land acquisition, zoning enforcement).
